profile.summary: I am a BSc.IT student at Asia Pacific University (Techspire College) with hands-on experience in software development, web technologies, mobile applications, databases, and interactive 3D experiences. I enjoy building practical applications and solving real-world problems using JavaScript, React Native, Node.js, MySQL, Python, and other technologies. I am looking for an opportunity to start my professional software development career, contribute to real-world projects, and continue growing as a developer.
